test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: At a certain rate of simple interest per annum a sum of money amounts to (13)/(8) of itself in 10 years. What is the rate of simple interest per annum?
solution:
Given: 

Simple Interest (SI) = 13/8 × Principle

Time period (T) = 10 years 

Formula used: 

SI = (P × R × T)/100 

Calculation: 

According to the question, 

Let the sum of money that's principal be x 

Amount after 10 years becomes = 13x/8 

⇒ SI = Amount - P = 13x/8 − x = 5x/8 

⇒ Rate per annum = (SI × 100)/(P × T) 

⇒ R = (5x/8 × 100)/( x × 10) 

⇒ R = 500/80 = 6.25% per annum.

∴ The rating percentage of the interest will be 6.25%.
